2608.09044.title: Tree-of-Experience: Hierarchical Experience Management for Self-Evolving Agents
2608.09044.paper_summary: Continual self-evolution requires LLM agents to transform environmental interactions into reliable and reusable experience. Existing methods typically refine individual trajectories or abstract shared knowledge from related trajectories, but their experience representations are often disconnected from the underlying reasoning process. This limits feedback attribution, cross-task transfer, and update and retrieval efficiency, particularly in complex reasoning tasks with outcome-level feedback. To overcome this limitation, we propose \textbf{T}ree-\textbf{o}f-\textbf{E}xperience (ToE), a structured experience-management framework that aligns experience organization with the hierarchical reasoning process of LLM agents. Specifically, ToE organizes the experience into a shared tree of analytical perspectives and reasoning paths, whose reliability is calibrated through environmental outcomes to support systematic updating, transfer, and efficient retrieval. The experimental results on \textsc{Game of 24} and \textsc{FinEvolveBench} show that ToE substantially improves both problem-solving performance and efficiency. On \textsc{Game of 24}, ToE achieves a 31.4\% relative improvement in accuracy over the experience-free ToT baseline. On \textsc{FinEvolveBench}, ToE improves tsIC by an average of 41.24\% over the experience-free pipeline across 12 evaluation settings, whereas conventional experience-management methods often underperform experience-free baselines.
2608.09044.paper_summary_zh: 持續的自我進化要求 LLM 代理將環境互動轉化為可靠且可重用的經驗。現有的方法通常會精煉個別軌跡或從相關軌跡中抽象共享知識，但它們的經驗表示往往與潛在的推理過程脫節。這限制了反饋歸因、跨任務轉移以及更新和檢索效率，特別是在具有結果級反饋的複雜推理任務中。為了克服這一限制，我們提出了 \textbf{T}ree-\textbf{o}f-\textbf{E}xperience (ToE)，這是一個結構化的經驗管理框架，將經驗組織與 LLM 代理的層次推理過程對齊。具體而言，ToE 將經驗組織成一個共享的分析視角和推理路徑的樹，其可靠性通過環境結果進行校準，以支持系統的更新、轉移和高效檢索。在 \textsc{Game of 24} 和 \textsc{FinEvolveBench} 上的實驗結果顯示，ToE 顯著提高了問題解決性能和效率。在 \textsc{Game of 24} 中，ToE 在準確性上相較於無經驗的 ToT 基線實現了 31.4\% 的相對提升。在 \textsc{FinEvolveBench} 中，ToE 在 12 個評估設置中平均提高了 41.24\% 的 tsIC，相較於無經驗的管道，而傳統的經驗管理方法通常表現不如無經驗的基線。
